ledger.claim: The rider did coordinate and the driver did not answer. EV-CHAT-02703 shows the driver writing 'hi im at the bay, where are you' at 07:53:25 and the rider replying 'coming' at 07:55:20, inside the waiting window; the driver posted nothing in the following 120 seconds and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 are made out. Limb (c) is not, and I do not pretend otherwise: the rider's own track in EV-GPS-02703 places the rider's device between 796.46 m and 804.18 m from the pickup pin (mean 800.51 m) across all 90 fixes, with rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against the 200 m rider-presence radius for TRANSPORT_HUB. Even on the reading most favourable to the rider - limb (c) undecidable because no fix survives the accuracy filter, POL-NS-11 - the clause still cannot exonerate, so this route yields the rider no refund.

The waiting-period arithmetic runs against the rider and I state it rather than stretch it. The free waiting period in force is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, carried on EV-TRIP-02703), and the derived arrival facts in EV-GPS-02703 show one continuous in-geofence run of 556 seconds, from 07:53:00 to 08:02:16, that is a shortfall of -256 seconds. The cancellation at 08:02:20 is 556 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so it also falls at or after the 480 second no_show_threshold_sec in force. POL-NS-06 - the rider's cleanest arithmetic route to a full refund of the cancellation-fee line - cannot be run on these numbers, and POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on them. EV-FARE-02703 shows the $5.00 cancellation fee charged with refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

The rider's side does not concede platform-confirmed arrival. The event chain in EV-TRIP-02703 runs driver_assigned, driver_en_route, driver_arrived, wait_timer_started, trip_cancelled - there is no wait_timer_expired event. POL-NS-12 makes the platform's GPS_AUTO arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace only where wait_timer_started AND wait_timer_expired are both carried, so on this record that route is not made out and the arrival and served-dwell facts must come out of the exported trace. I disclose honestly that this does not by itself displace the fee: EV-GPS-02703 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and shows the same 556 second continuous run, so the gap in the event chain removes a carrier without removing the fact the driver needs.

No advisory covers the pickup road: EV-ADVIS-02703-01 is MISSING, carries issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, and has no payload. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i) a present and populated traffic_advisory is the only thing that permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact can carry no fact at all. The rider therefore puts the driver's side to proof of any advisory-based excuse for its position or its intervals; the record supplies none. This is a citable absence rather than a fact, and it produces no refund here, because the driver's dwell is a single uninterrupted 556 second run that needs no accumulation.

Limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the face of the record: the trip_record carries a platform 'driver_arrived' event for this trip at 07:53:00, sourced from PLATFORM_TELEMETRY, and the arrival marker in force is GPS_AUTO rather than a driver-pressed button, so the arrival is the platform's own geofence measurement and not a driver's say-so.

Limb (b) is satisfied. The driver's own trace places him inside the arrival radius for the pickup zone class in force: the derived arrival facts for this artifact give a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 57 consecutive fixes from 07:53:00 to 08:02:16 at a 10 second cadence, on a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup where the radius is 150 m (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m.TRANSPORT_HUB). The run begins at the arrival event's own timestamp, so the in-geofence placement exists at or before that event.

Limb (c) is satisfied on the clock the clause prescribes. Dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from any arrival tap, and the derived facts put that fix at 07:53:00 (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0, arrived_at 07:53:00). The driver then held position inside the geofence for a single continuous run of 556 seconds, against a free waiting period in force of 300 seconds read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - an excess of 256 seconds, the shortfall being -256.0.

Limb (d) is satisfied, including the extra threshold this zone triggers. The trip was terminated by the driver at 08:02:20 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event and no started_at in the record. The cancellation falls 560 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:53:00, which is at or after both the 300 second free waiting period and the 480 second platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec that limb (c) requires to be respected where it is set and longer. RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three reason codes limb (d) recognises.

Arrival and the served waiting period also rest on an independent carrier under POL-NS-12. platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO, and the trip_record events record the platform's own geofence test at arrival - 'Driver GPS within 10 m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed' - together with wait_timer_started at 07:53:02 starting the 300 second free waiting period. Those are PLATFORM_TELEMETRY records of the platform's full-resolution measurement, independent of the exported trace, and no admissible fix in the exported trace contradicts them.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05, so the waiting clock is not recomputed and runs from 07:53:00. At the 07:53:00 marker the record places the driver within 10 m of the pickup pin and stationary at 0 km/h - neither the more-than-300 m distance trigger nor the 15 km/h motion trigger is met - and the driver's speed set across the trace is stationary during the whole in-geofence window.

The waiting-period shortfall that POL-NS-06 turns on does not exist here, and the clause's other route to a refund is unavailable. The measured shortfall is negative - derived.arrival.shortfall_sec is -256.0 - meaning the in-geofence dwell exceeds the free waiting period rather than falling short of it, and derived.arrival.run_count is 1, a single unbroken run, so limb (i)'s accumulation across separate in-geofence intervals is not needed to reach the minimum and the premature-cancellation refund has no purchase.

I disclose, as POL-GEN-02 requires, that EV-ADVIS-02703-01 is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0: no advisory covers the Woodlands Interchange PHV bay in this window. I do not assert it in either direction and my case does not depend on it - POL-NS-06(i) could only matter if the dwell were fragmented across intervals needing to be summed, and the trace shows one continuous 556 second interval already past the minimum.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, because its three limbs are conjunctive and two of them fail. Limb (a) requires a message whose content is locating or coordinating; the rider's only message, 'coming' at 07:55:20, names no position, entrance, block, tower or bay, does not ask for the driver's position and does not state that the vehicle cannot be seen. Limb (c) is affirmatively failed: the rider's own device logged 90 fixes whose minimum distance from the pickup pin is 796.46 m, and derived.arrival.rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 against the 200 m rider-presence radius for this zone class. The rider was not within the presence radius for a single qualifying fix, let alone the majority of them.

The chat log shows the coordination failure running toward the rider. The driver announced his arrival unprompted - 'hi im at the bay, where are you' at 07:53:25, read by the rider at 07:54:05 - and the rider's only answer, 'coming', came at 07:55:20. The driver then waited a further 7 minutes after that reply before cancelling at 08:02:20, at a bay the rider's own device never brought him within 796 m of.

POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route is not engaged on these facts and cannot be used to refund this fee. That clause decides a driver who was stationary outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin; here the stationary fixes are inside the 150 m radius, so the driver did arrive at the pickup point and POL-NS-01 limb (b) does not fail. The rider's device, by contrast, sat between 796.46 m and 804.18 m from the pin, beyond the clause's 400 m ceiling altogether. The venue_id comparison the clause describes is not needed, because no sub-location was specified by either party in the chat log.

No limb of POL-NS-08 impairs this bundle, so nothing in it is down-weighted. There is no (a) clock skew: the arrival event at 07:53:00 matches the first in-geofence fix at 07:53:00. There is no (b) trace defect: coverage is 100.0 percent, max_gap_sec is 0.0 with an empty gaps array, and the trace carries 117 fixes plus a rider track. There is no (c) chat defect: the log holds exactly the 2 messages trip_record.chat_message_count records, with msg_id sequence intact and read receipts present. There is no (d) fare defect: the cancellation-fee line of 5.00 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd for this trip.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force for the trip - the net figure read from platform_policy, 5.00 SGD, not the rider's gross. The ledger's own derivation states driver_compensation as 4.00, and the residual 1.00 is the platform's service fee, not money owed back to the rider.

The anti-farming guard in POL-NS-07 does not trip, so compensation is not withheld. That check requires BOTH limbs, and it fails at the first: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, well below the absolute threshold of 4, so the rate limb is never reached. Counsel is not relying on any profile field outside the nine POL-GEN-01 permits - in particular not on the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which is a different figure and cannot be substituted for the trailing-30-day one.

ledger.claim: No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so this case should be decided and not sent to review. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so the same-pair limb is not met; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the 3 that limb names; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip; and no admissible artifact contradicts the platform's arrival or dwell record, which agree with each other to the second.

The rider's assertion that he 'was still inside the interchange' is contradicted by his own device rather than merely uncorroborated. The rider track is available and holds 90 fixes whose distances from the pickup pin run from 796.46 m to 804.18 m with a mean of 800.51 m, every fix reporting 0 km/h. On the record's own coordinates the rider was some 800 m from the registered pickup point for the whole window.

The disputed sum is exactly the fee the driver earned, and the state it is in is the state it should stay in. platform_policy.fee_goes_to is DRIVER and cancellation_fee_sgd is 5.00; the ledger records total_charged 5.00 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. The correct emitted ruling is therefore DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and under POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries the same 4.00 figure as driver_compensation_sgd - it is the amount the ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the filing party, whose charge stands.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is owed $4.00 (80% of that fee), with $1.00 retained by the platform as its service fee.

Why the fee stands. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are made out. (a) The trip record carries the platform's own GPS_AUTO 'driver_arrived' event at 07:53:00. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB pickup at that same moment (nearest fix about 0.11 m from the pin, stationary at 0 km/h). (c) The driver held position in a single continuous in-geofence run of 556 seconds, from 07:53:00 to 08:02:16, against the free waiting period of 300 seconds read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - an excess of 256 seconds, the shortfall being -256.0. (d) The driver terminated at 08:02:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event, 560 seconds after the first in-geofence fix - at or after both the 300 s free period and the 480 s no_show_threshold_sec, and a reason code limb (d) recognises.

The rider's arguments. Your statement that you were 'still inside the interchange' is contradicted by your own device: the rider track in EV-GPS-02703 holds 90 fixes running from 796.46 m to 804.18 m from the pickup pin (mean 800.51 m), none inside the 200 m rider-presence radius. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you: even treating your 07:55:20 message 'coming' as a coordinating message and accepting that the driver did not reply within 120 seconds, limb (c) affirmatively fails on your own fixes - and if it were instead read as undecidable under POL-NS-11, the clause still could not exonerate you, so the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01 on the driver's evidence. POL-NS-06 gives no refund: the dwell exceeds the free period rather than falling short, and there is only one in-geofence run, so no accumulation under limb (i) is needed. POL-NS-03 is not engaged - the driver's stationary fixes lay inside the arrival radius, not outside it and within 400 m, and the trip has a single registered pickup point. Your point that POL-NS-12 is not made out is correct (there is no wait_timer_expired event in the chain), but it changes nothing: the exported trace is COMPLETE at full weight and establishes arrival and dwell on its own, and POL-NS-12 licenses no ruling value.

The driver's points. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the absolute threshold of 4, so the rate limb is never reached; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which is context-only under POL-GEN-01, was not used as a ground. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires (no same-pair disputes, no_show_disputes_30d = 1, no artefact conflict), so the case is decided rather than escalated. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (within 10 m, stationary), so no waiting clock is recomputed.

Integrity and weight. No limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged: no clock skew (arrival event and first in-geofence fix are both 07:53:00), no trace gap (max gap 0 s, 100% coverage, 117 fixes plus a rider track), the chat log holds exactly the 2 messages the trip record counts, and the $5.00 ledger line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02703-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact and nothing here rests on it. No claim was discarded at the mechanical check, and none is discarded on the merits.

Money. Cancellation fee in force: $5.00 (trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd; EV-FARE-02703 total_charged 5.00). Driver compensation: 80% x $5.00 = $4.00 (EV-FARE-02703 derived driver_compensation 4.00). Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries that same $4.00 - it is the amount the ruling moves, not a refund to the rider, whose $5.00 charge stands. The monetary effect ($4.00) is at or below the $8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

Confidence 0.95, capped by the deciding artifacts at weight 1.0 (EV-GPS-02703 and EV-TRIP-02703, which agree to the second). No referrals are produced by any clause.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
